title: Thomas Wortmann, Judyta Cichocka and Adrian Krężlik | IASS 2017 Pre-Symposium Master Class - September 22-24, Hamburg (Germany)
description: Interfacing Architecture, Engineering and Mathematical Optimization September 22-24, 2017 Hamburg (Germany) Thomas Wortmann, **Judyta Cichocka, **and Adrian Krężlik will host a Master Class at the IASS 2017 Conference in Hamburg, Germany. Join them to: Learn how to use simulation-based optimization in Grasshopper Learn about the differences between optimization algorithms in Grasshopper and when to use them Learn how to assess the performance of optimization algorithms Learn about differ…
